# Ursine
## Strong Toss Ursine arms have a musculature which has been developed for grappling and tossing. As such, people they can [color=#ffa500]they can throw people farther, faster, and their throws hurt more.[/color]
## Slow and Shoeless Ursine are quite sluggish, moving [color=#1e90ff]25% slower than a human.[/color] As well, due to their big foot paws, they [color=#1e90ff]can't wear shoes.[/color]
## Damage Like their animalistic cousins, Ursine are quite bulky giving them a [ccolor=#ffa500f]20% resistance to blunt and slashing damage.[/color] However, the fat which gives them their resistances is also vulnerable to puncturing, giving them a [color=#1e90ff]15% vulnerability to piercing damage.[/color] Their fur also lets them be more insulated against the cold, giving them a [color=#ffa500]15% resistance to cold damage.[/color] Unfortunately, this insulation against the cold works negatively in the heat, giving them a [color=#1e90ff]20% vulnerability to heat damage.[/color]
## Ursine Naming Conventions Upon reaching adulthood, an Ursine chooses their first name. This name, traditionally, is selected on a basis of their favorite thing to consume, be it food, liquid, or booze. Then, given by their peers or a diviner, is an epiphet. This epiphet is either an embodiment of an aspect of the Ursine or an emodiment of an aspect of the life of an Ursine, be it their past or future. ## Lore
The Ursine, despite being far from the systems with the most life, seem to hold a lot of knowledge of the goings on of the species of the wider universe. Though this still remains a mystery, there are multiple theories on how this is possible. The first theory involves the ancient rumors of devices scattered throughout the universe which can do actions on a galaxy-sized scale. The theory goes that a device of this nature was discovered in the history of the Ursine, and even after it was long forgotten the stories of the stars still persist. The secondary theory is mainly propogated by the Space Wizard Federation. This theory states that rather than a device being the means in which the Ursine discovered the wider galaxy, it was actually via a series of major prophets who could see the galaxy on a larger scale. Both theories have a lot of credit and methods of disproving, and as such it is believed this will remain another mystery of the galaxy.
